exclusion_policy: Third-party frozen FLA/flame trees, environments, caches, datasets, checkpoints, binary builds and generated run logs are excluded. Source, shell launchers, docs, patches and configuration manifests are retained. Identical files use relative symlinks.

integration_sources.examples/komp: Portable trainer adapted from the frozen model/loss/optimizer contract; token-file input and checkpoint orchestration are new; original document-stream/DDP trainers remain in history.
